words.gloss: if one is able to examine

literal: One's own fault having removed, others' fault if able to examine, what fault will happen to the leader?
translation: If a leader first removes their own faults and then examines the faults of others, what fault can ever come upon them?
modern: தலைவன் தன் குற்றத்தை முதலில் நீக்கிவிட்டு, அதன் பிறகு பிறருடைய குற்றத்தை ஆராய்ந்து பார்ப்பானானால், அவனுக்கு என்ன குற்றம் நேரிடும்?
explanation: This couplet highlights the essential quality of self-correction in leadership. A leader must first identify and eliminate their own flaws before attempting to judge or correct the mistakes of others. If a leader possesses this level of self-awareness and integrity, no blame or failure can ever touch them. The word 'iṟai' refers to a leader or ruler, and 'kāṇkiṟpin' emphasizes the capacity to examine or judge others' faults only after self-rectification.
